caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden sign with a painted illustration in the upper section and the word "TEMPERANCE" in large, gold capital letters on a black background in the lower section. Within the illustrated portion, a white horse is positioned on the left side, facing and moving right, with its legs outstretched as if galloping. The horse is harnessed and pulling a two-wheeled chariot, which is drawn in pale orangish-red. Seated in the chariot is a human figure with light skin, wearing a long dark green garment and a dark hat with a feather or plume. The figure holds a torch in the left hand and an arrow or spear in the right hand, which is raised. The background behind the horse and chariot is a grayish tone, and the entire scene is framed within a dark wooden border with finials at the top corners. The sign shows visible cracks and aging in the wood.
title: Tavern Sign: "Temperance"
